Container.Name: gpu-process-exporter
Container.Overview: Tiny sidecar that polls "nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps" every 5s and writes the GPU process count to InfluxDB (measurement "gpu", field "proc_count") so it can be graphed in Grafana. Glances' own GPU plugin does not expose a process-count field, so this fills that gap using the same base image (already has nvidia-smi, curl, bash via --runtime=nvidia). Entrypoint is overridden to run /gpu-process-count.sh instead of Glances itself.
Container.Requires: Requires the "monitoring" Docker network, an influxdb container reachable at hostname "influxdb" on that network, and the script at /mnt/user/appdata/glances/scripts/gpu-process-count.sh on the host.

Config.Name: Script
Config.Description: Polling script (nvidia-smi -> InfluxDB line protocol via curl)

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: All GPUs visible (dual 3060, per-GPU breakdown via nvidia-smi loop)
